# Version 4.153.0
> **Font selection and GPU correctness** · Released September 21, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.153.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 brings Skia m153 with Linux font-fallback changes and GPU correctness fixes.

## Breaking Changes

- **Make Linux fallback fonts explicit when needed** — FontConfig now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback, which can select a different face and change glyphs or text metrics. Choose an explicit family/style or bundle a typeface when deterministic font selection matters. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826))

## Bug Fixes

- **Windows HarfBuzz BinSkim compatibility** — The bundled libHarfBuzzSharp.dll now passes BA2007 by scoping truncation-warning suppression to vendored source. Existing unrelated BinSkim warnings are unchanged. ([#5120](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5120))
- **GPU buffer upload failures** — Ganesh rejects incomplete buffers and drops affected draws when GPU uploads fail under memory pressure, rather than drawing stale contents. Triangulated paths retain CPU vertex data for a later upload attempt. ([#5116](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5116))
- **Cached-data teardown safety** — Releases the native cached-data mutex guard before deleting its owner, preventing access to a mutex in freed storage. ([#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927))
- **Glyph-atlas and GPU failure handling** — Prevents partial glyph updates from reusing evicted atlas locations and propagates Ganesh task, flush, and submission failures internally. Existing managed flush methods remain void. ([#5062](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5062))

## Engine

- **Skia m153** — Updates the bundled renderer to m153. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.2.1.300 while its native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.2.1. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

The Windows native library now passes BinSkim BA2007 through source-scoped warning suppression. Package revision 14.2.1.300 does not upgrade the native HarfBuzz 14.2.1 engine.

## Release Candidate 1 (September 6, 2026)

Cut the release candidate with release-workflow changes only; this bucket adds no consumer-facing API or rendering changes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6...v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2)

## Preview 1 (September 3, 2026)
